opportunities.name: FlightAware compare plan tiers for a product
opportunities.description: Open FlightAware's Products menu, pick a product, and open its tier or subscription comparison page, optionally continuing to an upgrade.
steps: Click the 'Products' span in the top navigation.
Click the product name in the submenu (for example, 'AeroAPI' or 'Premium Subscriptions').
Click the comparison button or link ('Compare Tiers Now' or 'Compare Subscriptions').
Optionally click 'Upgrade' on the comparison page.
